forum.title: VD56G3 camera change the Frame start and frame end
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Brenden\_PLUS ,

There is no such register on our sensor to play with the delay between two packets.

Sorry for the inconvenience,

Best regards,

Jean
forum.content_text:
Can you increase the delay between Start and end frame packets.

I want to make sure there's enough time for it to be detected with the STM32N6.

Registers i've tried to use.

\* VSYNC\_START\_DELAY - is for gpio output

\* FSYNC\_IN\_DELAY - not sure what it does
